name: ST7305 Reflective LCD Display
description: The `st7305` display platform drives reflective monochrome LCD panels based on the Sitronix ST7305 and ST7306 controllers over a 4-wire [SPI bus](https://esphome.io/components/spi/). These panels are 1 bit per pixel, have no backlight and retain their image. The built-in `WAVESHARE-400X300` model describes the 4.2" panel on the Waveshare ESP32-S3-RLCD-4.2 (400x300 in landscape). Other panels can be described with the `CUSTOM` model.

config_entries.label: SPI ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of the [SPI Component](https://esphome.io/components/spi/) if there are multiple SPI buses.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: The interval to re-draw the screen. Defaults to `1s`.

config_entries.label: Model
config_entries.description: The panel model. One of `WAVESHARE-400X300` (default) or `CUSTOM`.

config_entries.label: CS Pin
config_entries.description: The chip select pin. Required for `CUSTOM`; the `WAVESHARE-400X300` model supplies GPIO40.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Input
config_entries.description: Set the input mode flag.

config_entries.label: Output
config_entries.description: Set the output mode flag.

config_entries.label: Pullup
config_entries.description: Set the pullup mode flag.

config_entries.label: Pulldown
config_entries.description: Set the pulldown mode flag.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.description: Set to `true` for a panel that packs 4x2 pixels per byte (portrait native orientation). Set to `false` for the 2x4 landscape layout. Required for `CUSTOM`; the `WAVESHARE-400X300` model sets it to `false`.
